text:
jordan: Quick Q 022: planning to work from Bali for ~10 weeks (Aug 1	Oct 9). Will the WFH stipend continue? Any payroll/tax actions I need to take? Also curious about health coverage while abroad.
sam: +1 from me to approve time off/remote. Jordan, please loop in people-ops for paperwork.
aya: Hey Jordan 022: short checklist: 1) submit Temporary Remote form: https://intra.redwood/work-requests/temporary-remote 2) add travel dates to Homebase (do NOT change legal home base) 3) notify manager & attach approval 4) payroll & intl-tax will review for nexus. Stipend: default $120/mo, pro-rated by days.
jordan: Thanks 022: when you say "do NOT change legal home base" do you mean keep US address? Also Bali022: any special visa concerns for ~10 weeks?
ay a: Yes keep legal home base as-is. For Indonesia, tourist visa durations vary by nationality; many get 30	or 60-day entry. If you need longer, check entry rules or consider a visa on arrival extension. Legal will confirm; pinging Lee & Katie.
lee: Intl payroll here 022: 10 weeks (~70 days) is under common 183-day residency thresholds, but Indonesia has rules and tax treaties to consider. Main ask for us: exact dates, whether you'll be working for/with any Indonesian entities, and whether you'll be paid or invoiced locally. If you remain on US payroll and no local contracting, we typically keep US tax withholding. Attach dates to the form so we can clear nexus risk.
katie: Benefits 022: short trips keep health coverage active. For Indonesia, medical care availability varies; please carry international travel insurance and check pre-authorization rules in the benefits portal: https://intra.redwood/benefits/faq#abroad If you expect routine care, contact benefits team before departure.
jordan: Cool. About stipend math 022: if I022:m there all of Aug and half of Sept how is $120 pro-rated?
aya: Example: August full month = $120. September 15 days remote -> $120/30*15 = $60. Payroll will split across pay runs. If trip spans payroll cutoffs we pro-rate by calendar days. If you want a flat month payout request in the form; manager can approve but not guaranteed.
jordan: Any other operational gotchas? equipment, local bank, POA?
lee: Bring company laptop, avoid connecting to local contractor pools, and do NOT sign local contracts. Do not open local payroll or bank accounts in company name. If you need local invoicing for short gigs, warn us first.
sam: Thanks 022: please @me once Payroll confirms final clearance.
payroll-bot: Temp Remote request submitted by jordan on 1800020011. Notifying Payroll & Tax teams to review. (automated)
jordan: Thanks all, filing the temporary remote form now.
